provenance.canonical_layout: SEC XBRL company-concept payloads for the balance-sheet concepts and the cover-page share counts, each the byte-exact company-concept response with the facts the API does not yet carry taken from the filing's own inline XBRL instance, plus the canonical price series and acceptance evidence reused by path from data/historical_pe/AEP. The trailing revenue and EBITDA denominators are the data/historical_income/AEP dataset's own windows, executed from its config, never recomputed here.

concept_fetch.transport: HTTPS GET data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyconcept/CIK0000004904/us-gaap/{tag}.json with a declared contactable User-Agent, honouring the SEC fair-access policy
concept_fetch.response_units: verbatim as returned: USD for every concept

cash_concept.json.definition: Cash and cash equivalents at carrying value, the liquid-funds component of the filed EV bridge.

marketable_securities_current_concept.js.definition: American Electric Power's current marketable securities. It reports the line as 'Short-term investments' and carries it on us-gaap:ShortTermInvestments; it does not use us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesCurrent at all, so the bridge's role is filled by the element the issuer uses.

commercial_paper_concept.json.definition: Commercial paper, a total-debt component of the filed EV bridge.

long_term_debt_current_concept.json.definition: Long-term debt due within one year, a total-debt component of the filed EV bridge.

long_term_debt_noncurrent_concept.json.definition: Long-term debt, non-current, a total-debt component of the filed EV bridge.

shares_outstanding_concept.json.definition: The cover-page share counts (dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding). American Electric Power has no historical P/FCF dataset, so this is the dataset's own input. The counts are never split-adjusted and pair with the as-traded close.

daily_prices.json (reused by path).source: The canonical daily price series, read by path. There is no split in the covered period, so the close and the cover-page count pair without adjustment.

filing_acceptance_evidence.json (reused.source: The canonical acceptance index, read by path. A fact whose filing is not in the index has no knowability evidence in this dataset and is skipped.

provenance.point_in_time_rule: usable_date is derived from acceptance_datetime_header_et using the 16:00 ET cutoff rule at load time, identical to the historical P/E, P/FCF and income pipelines. The value in force at an evaluation date is the latest knowable version of each component; no fact is used before its filing's usable date.

multiple_rules.ps: P/S = (as-traded close on the evaluation date x latest knowable cover-page shares outstanding) / TTM revenue, where the TTM revenue window is the income dataset's own four-consecutive-fiscal-quarter window. A non-positive denominator produces no multiple.
multiple_rules.ev_ebitda: EV/EBITDA = (market capitalization + total debt [long-term debt non-current + long-term debt current + commercial paper] - liquid funds [cash and cash equivalents + current marketable securities]) / TTM EBITDA. Every bridge component must be knowable at the evaluation date, and every one of them must describe the SAME balance-sheet date: a date whose components span more than one balance sheet publishes no enterprise value, with the reason REASON_MIXED_BALANCE_SHEET_PERIODS. The bridge is never completed by omission, substitution or zero-fill, and a component that was not reported is not carried forward as zero. Market capitalization is not a balance-sheet component and is not part of the same-date rule. The bridge remains a partial statement of enterprise value even when complete (it omits leases, non-current investments and off-balance sheet claims) and every observation says so.

provenance.reference_gate: The same >= 20 qualifying observations rule as every other production distribution. A thinner sample stays descriptive and is never a scenario exit multiple. The two distributions are qualified independently: one qualifying does not qualify the other.
known_limitations: The revenue role's element covers only the fiscal 2023 annual figure onward, so the P/S distribution holds four qualifying observations and is reported as a short sample rather than as a reference.

Microsoft's own fiscal declarations contradict each other about the quarter ended 2021-03-31, so the windows that need that position are refused with REASON_FISCAL_POSITION_UNRESOLVED. The EV/EBITDA distribution holds 24 qualifying observations, which the shared gate admits.
The reconstructed enterprise value omits operating leases, non-current investments and off-balance sheet commitments. It is labelled partial on every observation.
The evaluation dates are the filing usable dates shared with the income reconstruction, not a continuous daily trading history.
